verdicts.reason: A breaks up the design: the lavender circle has been moved to the top corner, away from the product it sat behind. There is a big gap between the '20% off' headline and 'Every mixed case.', so the subcopy reads as part of the button. The product is small, the left edges are slightly off from each other (10 vs 15px), and the fine print is tiny. B keeps one clean left edge and a strong two-line headline, and the circle stays behind the product as in the original. Its flaws: the 'Shop Sale' button nearly touches the side margins, 'off' sits alone on its own line, and there is a dead gap between the product and the fine print at the bottom.
